summary: Verified 7.5/10, ON PAR by ruling 8 (no blocker), at the edge. Load was 178 at check time, so I made no fresh capture and no timing claims. I re-read every cited artifact. `git diff b4cf39106` on the three marund GLBs is empty, so the build matches. The in-match read is good: the cap stays level, attack1 lands on the target, the leap rises and idle moves. Both majors are confirmed. The six cards are brush-filtered renders: blocky facets on the face, a figure that looks pasted on, base and Long Evening in the same pose, and the Gorgewalk crouch floating over a chasm on a hard shadow line. In the attack2 hit frame the maul is at the boot while the ribbon is on the target, and both attacks play the identical [62,-58,14] arc. Sensitivity is clean across the model, the icon, 3 portraits and 3 splashes: the low flat disc cap is no hood, and the carved mask is not horror (the Gorgewalk white slabs read as tusks).

findings.title: Splash/portrait cards are brush-filtered renders; base and Long Evening share a pose
findings.what: All six cards are renders run through a brush filter: the face, cap and hands break into smeared flat facets, and the figure is lit warm and flat against a softer plate, so it looks pasted on. Base and Long Evening share the lean-on-maul pose. One addition: the Gorgewalk crouch hovers over the chasm in the plate, and a hard horizontal shadow line at about y=735 cuts across the ravine.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/marund/splash.png, marund_long_evening_splash.png (same pose), marund_gorgewalk_splash.png (figure over the chasm, hard shadow line), marund_gorgewalk_portrait.png, marund_long_evening_portrait.png (pink tongue under the moustache)
findings.gauge: LoL base and skin splashes are fully painted with one light story and a distinct pose per skin. Portraits are clean face reads.
findings.fix: Paint over the beauty, ID and light passes in VALE's own lacquer style. Give each skin its own story pose. Ground the figure on a plate surface with a key-matched rim light. Fill the mouth with the linen wrap.
findings.verifierNote: Viewed all six cards at full size. Facet blocking and the shared pose are plain. Not a blocker: the cards are legible, the silhouette reads, and there is no sensitivity issue.

findings.title: attack2 does not connect at the hit frame; both attacks share one ribbon arc
findings.what: In the attack2 hit frame the maul head sits by his left boot pointing down, while the mint ribbon is drawn on the dummy. attack1 and attack2 fire the identical ribbon arc.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing2_marund_swing_attack2_crop.png against closing2_marund_swing_attack1_crop.png. _harness/_reports/closing2_marund_swing_clip_marund.json arc [62,-58,14] on both clips. content/vfx.json has one marund_atk_swing (line 46087) for both.
findings.gauge: Each LoL auto-attack variant shows the weapon at the target on the hit frame, with a trail along its own path.
findings.fix: Re-time attack2 so the maul head crosses the facing axis at about 1.2 m out on the hit tick. Give attack2 a low, flat ribbon of its own and attack1 a vertical chop arc.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced from the shots: the trail and the weapon are visibly disconnected. Auto-attacks are seen constantly, so major is the right severity.

findings.title: Ult beat floods the model flat mint
findings.what: During the Domefall beat Marund renders as one translucent mint silhouette.
findings.gauge: LoL ults keep the caster readable through the cast VFX.
findings.fix: Fresnel-only dome shell, or exclude the caster from the tint pass.
findings.verifierNote: Seen in the shot. A short beat, so minor.

findings.title: Shelter Dome maul never clears the cap rim
findings.what: The cast_a2 maul peaks at 1.55 m, under the 1.6-1.86 m rim.
findings.gauge: Defining cast poses clear the silhouette.
findings.fix: Push the maul out past the rim edge before the plant.
findings.verifierNote: Numbers check out against the report.

findings.title: No apron sway bones
findings.what: The GLB has no x_apron_f or x_apron_b. Its only x_ nodes are x_cap and x_cap_tip.
findings.evidence: strings art/out/fighters/marund/marund.glb | grep x_ -> x_cap, x_cap_tip only
findings.gauge: LoL champions have secondary motion on large cloth.
findings.fix: Add one-bone apron chains with baked lag.

findings.title: Pink mouth/tongue cavity and white moustache slabs in close views
findings.what: A pink tongue shape shows under the moustache, and on Gorgewalk the keel and moustache are white slabs.
findings.gauge: LoL face sculpts hold clean shapes at portrait size.
findings.fix: Fill the mouth recess with the cloth wrap and roll off the moustache ends.
findings.verifierNote: Visible. Not a horror read (tusk-like), so it stays minor.
